minutes.headline: Building committee voted to put only an update article, not a cost article, on the spring Town Meeting warrant.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed spring Town Meeting warrant articles while the architect contract is still being negotiated. It voted for a single update article asking Town Meeting to hear a report, with any funding request likely at a later special town meeting. It also covered Brooks House land ownership, outreach, town office consolidation and a meeting schedule.

what_happened.line: The Building Design Committee voted to put only an update article, with no cost article, on the May Town Meeting warrant; the count was not audible.
The committee will ask Town Meeting only to hear a report from it, and any funding request would likely come at a later special town meeting.
The architect contract is still being negotiated, with optional add-on items, so the overall price is not yet known.
The architect is to be asked to talk with DPW and other offices about moving town offices into the building.
Meetings were tentatively set for the 4th, 11th and 25th of March, with none the following week unless the architect is ready.

why_it_matters: Residents will not be asked to vote on a project cost at the spring Town Meeting, because no cost article is planned; a funding request, and any borrowing, would come later.

A member noted that borrowing exempted from the tax limit would need a special election and a two-thirds vote at a special town meeting, so the size of the borrowing would reach tax bills only after those votes.
